info.title: Create Custom Engagement Task
info.description:
Create an engagement task that uses a self-defined custom message instead of predefined message templates from TikTok Shop. The task acts as a container for grouping messages with similar content and rules, allowing sellers to track and compare task performance across different types of content.
Note that each task has a mandatory end time, and once expired, it cannot be used to send additional messages.

parameters.name: x-tts-access-token
parameters.description: The seller access_token value from [Get Access Token](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/678e3a3292b0f40314a92d75#Get%20Access%20Token%20API), when user_type = 0. Follow this [guide](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/678e3a344ddec3030b238fa0) to get seller access_token.

parameters.name: app_key
parameters.description: Every single app will have a unique key. Please use the specific key assigned to your app.

parameters.name: sign
parameters.description: Signature generated by gen algorithm. When you send API requests to TTS, you must sign them so that TTS can identify the senders.

parameters.name: timestamp
parameters.description: Unix timestamp GMT (UTC+00:00). This timestamp is used across all API requests. Developers can use this convert to local time.

parameters.name: idempotency_key
parameters.description:
A unique key to recognize a request and prevent duplicate processing of the same request, especially in cases of connection issues. Ensure this key is unique for each request to avoid accidental duplicates.
Note: We recommend that you generate v4 UUIDs for use as keys.

parameters.name: shop_cipher
parameters.description:
Use this property to pass shop information in requesting the API. Failure in passing the correct value when requesting the API for cross-border shops will return incorrect response. 
Get by API [Get Authorization Shop](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/6507ead7b99d5302be949ba9?external_id=6507ead7b99d5302be949ba9)

parameters.name: body
parameters.description: Request body. Full source table is retained in x-tiktok-request-body-parameters.

end_time.description: The time at which the task ends, and messages will no longer be sent. Unix timestamp (seconds).

channel.description: The engagement channel. Only `TIKTOK_IM` is supported.

product_ids.description:
The product IDs that you want to include as interactive cards in the message. Retrieve this value from the [Search Products API](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/65854ffb8f559302d8a6acda).
Max count: 4

coupon_ids.description:
The coupon IDs that you want to include as interactive cards in the message. 
Max count: 1
You can only add coupons that have one of these sets of property:
- `coupons.display_type=REGULAR` and `coupons.target_buyer_segment=ALL`
- `coupons.display_type=REGULAR` and `coupons.target_buyer_segment=REPEAT_CUSTOMERS`.
Find out the coupon ID and properties from the [Search Coupons API](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/6699dcdf115ebe02f841e4cd).

title.description:
The message title. 
- Valid format: plain text, unicode emoji (UTF-8)
- Valid length: [1, 70]

body.description:
The message body.
- Valid format: plain text, unicode emoji (UTF-8)
- Valid length:  [1, 500]

custom_message.description: The custom message to send to customers.

200.description: Successful response. See source Markdown for complete semantics.

code.description: The success or failure status code returned in API response.

message.description: The success or failure messages returned in API response. Reasons of failure will be described in the message.

task_id.description: The unique identifier for the customer engagement task. Pass this value in the [Send Engagement Message API](67777e448e882e030d29676e) to associate the task with the message sending operation.
